remarks: Seize this rare opportunity to create your dream home on one of Westport's most coveted cul-de-sacs. Nestled in a picturesque setting, this cleared, buildable lot offers the perfect blend of privacy and convenience. Surrounded by lush greenery, yet just moments from Westport's finest amenities, you'll enjoy easy access to downtown, Longshore, Compo Beach, shopping, and transportation hubs. Plus, the library, Levitt Pavilion, and Westport Country Playhouse are just a short distance away, with Winslow Park within walking distance.Land in this highly sought-after area is a rare find, making this a truly special chance to build in one of Westport's most desirable neighborhoods. An updated feasibility study is available, showcasing the potential for a stunning 5-6 bedroom home. This is your opportunity to experience the ultimate Westport lifestyle in this exceptional location.
